headline: Dominican president questioned over past actions
subheadline: Invokes need for accountability among leaders
author: Na
content: Decidedly controversial figures who once held presidential office face scrutiny today. One notable example involves former President Keuzynski's recent approval of legislation aimed at preventing future collaborations with companies similar to those involved in scandals.

headline: Lopezoya case moves forward despite challenges
subheadline: Keuzynski approves law against corrupt firms
author: Na
content: The legal proceedings concerning Lopezoya continue amidst obstacles. Recently, President Keuzynski endorsed a regulation intended to deter associations with businesses akin to those implicated in previous controversies.

headline: Pearls of wisdom from Pope Francis on Peru’s saints
subheadline: Emphasizes devotion towards national religious icons
author: Na
content: In his message conveyed through Cardinal Cipriani, Pope Francis expressed profound reverence toward Peruvians’ patron saints, including Saint Rose of Lima and St. Martin de Porres, highlighting their significance within our cultural heritage.

headline: Inaugural admission exams commence at National University of Engineering
subheadline: Over four thousand students compete for limited spots
author: Na
content: Starting tomorrow, more than four thousand aspirants will undertake entrance examinations at the National University of Engineering which offers eight hundred fifty-one vacancies across various engineering disciplines.

headline: Auctioning commercial properties promises enhanced safety measures
subheadline: New gallery boasts state-of-the-art fire prevention systems
author: Na
content: Upcoming sales include several commercial units located in a newly inaugurated shopping complex featuring advanced anti-fire technology ensuring unparalleled security standards.

headline: Juan Vargas estará en la volante para darle una variante al equipo con sus peligrosos remates desde fuera del área.
content: A su lado, el venezolano Arquímedes Figuera sabe lo que se juegan. “Solo pensamos en los tres puntos. Otro resultado no vale”, señaló.

headline: Gasto militar aumenta significativamente según reporte oficial.
content: Según datos proporcionados por el Ministerio de Defensa, el presupuesto destinado a mejorar infraestructura militar experimentó un incremento notable respecto al ejercicio fiscal anterior.

headline: Aumento de casos COVID-19 alerta autoridades sanitarias locales.
content: Las cifras reveladas por el Instituto Nacional de Salud reflejan un preocupante aumento en contagios, especialmente en áreas urbanas densamente pobladas.

author: NA
